notes.title: Compensation for Veterans
notes.content:
Dear warriors,


500,000 cash (ingame currency) and 20 crates has been sent to all players who paid for Mini Battlegrounds. Sorry for all the inconveniences and thanks for all your supports and understanding.
The game will go free to play within this week. Please invite your friends to join in for free.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32162324/ed30719242bdf7782b6032a95fcf46f8efafa5fc.jpg


MBGs Team
20.8.2018

notes.title: Mini Battlegrounds will go free to play!
notes.content:
Dear players,

Although most streamers love our game, when they play it with their friends and fans in real-time, Mini Battlegrounds is still suffering from a low player base.

So we decided to release the gate and make it free to play for everyone.

Here are the videos from our streamer team, thanks for all the amazing joyful  content they made. 

https://steamcommunity.com/app/658470/discussions/0/1694918539662620732/


MBGs Team
16.8.2018

notes.title: Volunteer Translator Recruiting
notes.content:
Volunteer Translator Recruiting

Dear Warriors,
We've received many requests to make the game in multi-language and we always believe the best talents are among our players.
So we start recruiting volunteer translator for Mini Battlegrounds now!
(The language pack is relatively small for this PVP games, require 1-2 day work time at the most)

Recent languages required on schedule -
Japanese,German,French,Spanish,Korean
(You can suggest other languages that you mastered too.)

- Requirement -
1. Love Mini Battlegrounds.
2. Purchased a copy on Steam or played for more than 10 hours.
3. Bilingual and perfectionist.

- How to apply -
Send an email to "support [at] ioa.online" with the following info.
1. Self intro and languages you mastered.
2. A screenshot of Steam receipt or record playtime.
3. Steam full name
4. Ingame nickname
5. Gmail address(Google Mail)
6. Age
7. Discord or Skype ID

- Rewards -
This is mostly a volunteer job, but we do provide some ingame rewards from time to time.
1. A few keys for your family and friends
2. DLC keys with new skins and costumes when they're ready.
3. Direct communication with developer staffs.
4. Chances to become a volunteer moderator on official Facebook and Discord.

Love to hear from you soon.
Best,

Mini Battlegrounds operation team
20.3.2018

More details...

notes.title: Beta Release
notes.content:
Fellow Warriors,

For a limited time during our early access test release, the full version of Mini Battlegrounds will be available for $5 USD. 
We want to work closely with the community to take feedback and improve the game as much as possible to deliver the best experience we can. Making the game available at a lower price point will allow us to hear from a wider audience of players, and improve the game a bit more quickly. 
Beta testing rewards will only be given to players that purchase the game during the early release.

See you on the battlegrounds

-Mini Battlegrounds Team
9.3.2018
